Seasoned technology leader with 16+ years of experience, currently focused on building production-grade Generative AI solutions. Leveraging a deep foundation in Systems Design, I bring a rare blend of enterprise- grade solutioning and cutting-edge AI development.

 z’‘\ CORE COMPETENCIES	

Generative AI:

Large Language Models (LLM) • Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) • AI Agents • Chatbot

LangChain • LangGraph • CrewAI • Vector Database • FAISS • ChromaDB • HuggingFace

Prompt Engineering • OpenAPI • ChatGPT • Groq • Llama • Mistral

Python • FastAPI • Docker • Microsoft Azure

Tools:

VS Code • Google Colab Professional • Jupyter Note • Git • GitHub

PROJECTS

YouTube Trend Analyzer| Tech Stack: AI Agents, Groq, FastAPI, Python, Docker, AWS

Developed a multi-agent system to fetch trending YouTube videos, analyze comment sentiment, and generate LLM-based summaries.

Orchestrated with LangGraph; deployed with Docker + AWS EC2 for real-time trend insights.

Hybrid RAG| Tech Stack: RAG, LangChain, ChromaDB, FastAPI, Docker, AWS EC2, Python

Developed a production-grade Hybrid RAG system that ingests and retrieves information from diverse file formats including .pdf, .txt, .docx and .html.

Containerized with Docker, deployed via FastAPI on AWS EC2 for scalable, real-time access.

Research Paper Finder| Tech Stack: RAG, FastAPI, Docker, AWS EC2, Python

Implemented a RAG-based AI search tool to retrieve, summarize, and filter research papers from arXiv and other academic APIs.

The system was containerized with Docker, hosted on AWS EC2, and made accessible via a FastAPI backend and Streamlit frontend for real-time Proof-of-Concept (POC)

Medical Chatbot| TechStack: Llama-3, RAG, LangChain, Prompt Engineering, Python

Developed a lightweight, cost-efficient Medical QA chatbot using open-source LLaMA 3 (8B) with optimized RAG architecture tailored for deployment in low-resource environments.

Integrated custom prompt engineering and an evaluation framework leveraging NLP metrics.

-¡Au EXPERIENCE	

 ⬛ LogicWind | Remote | GenAI Developer - Freelance	Jan 2024 - Currently

Strong ability to customize LLM workflows with prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and hybrid retrieval methods to fit unique client needs.
